notes: Open. Proved: A094358.A094358_subset_munafo (every term satisfies 2^^n == 1 mod n) and A094358.munafo_conjecture_iff (conjecture <-> every Fermat number squarefree), via A094358.munafo_iff (2^^n == 1 mod n <-> n | 2^(2^j) - 1 for some j; order of 2 in (ZMod n)^x) and prod of Fermat numbers = 2^(2^j) - 1. Outside Lean: none for the equivalence; squarefreeness of Fermat numbers is an open problem.

sources.cite: OEIS A094358 (rev. #66), comments by M. Alekseyev, J. S. Nielsen, J. Song
